name: useDarkMode
description: A hook for managing dark mode state with support for system preference detection and manual mode switching.
usage_guidelines: Use for implementing dark mode toggle functionality.
Automatically detects system color scheme preference.
Syncs mode with theme store for persistence.
Updates document root class for CSS styling.
Supports three modes: light, dark, and system.

return_value.description: Tuple with current dark mode state and mode change function.

isEnabled.description: True if dark mode is currently active.

Dont: Don't force mode without user consent
Don't forget to handle system mode
Don't block rendering on mode detection
